# truenas_ssh_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS SSH service configuration. This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one SSH configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls ssh.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place, since management access to the box may depend on it). SSH host keys are server-managed and are not modeled by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_ssh_config" "config" {
  tcpport      = 22
  passwordauth = false
  tcpfwd       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bindiface` (List of String) Interfaces to bind the SSH service to. Empty list binds to all interfaces.
- `compression` (Boolean) Whether SSH compression is enabled.
- `kerberosauth` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos authentication is enabled.
- `options` (String) Extra sshd_config options, appended verbatim.
- `password_login_groups` (List of String) Groups whose members are allowed to authenticate with a password.
- `passwordauth` (Boolean) Whether password authentication is enabled.
- `sftp_log_facility` (String) SFTP subsystem syslog facility. One of "" (default), DAEMON, USER, AUTH, LOCAL0-LOCAL7. Not validated by this provider.
- `sftp_log_level` (String) SFTP subsystem syslog level. One of "" (default), QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, DEBUG1, DEBUG2, DEBUG3. Not validated by this provider.
- `tcpfwd` (Boolean) Whether TCP forwarding is enabled.
- `tcpport` (Number) TCP port the SSH service listens on.
- `weak_ciphers` (List of String) Weak ciphers to allow. Valid values: AES128-CBC, NONE.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "ssh_config".
